title: BIR eyes expansion of abatement program for micro taxpayers

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) is now studying whether to expand its One-Time Abatement Program for Micro Taxpayers after noting a strong response to it. In a statement on Wednesday, the BIR pointed out that, in the four months since the program was established, it has recorded 3,929 beneficiaries and P266.79 million in taxes and penalties abated, as of Oct. 24, 2026. According to the BIR, that level of availment shows that targeted tax relief can help taxpayers settle covered obligations and clear long-pending tax cases.
